# Spectrum: Concordia University Research Repository

> Spectrum is Concordia University's institutional research repository for managing, preserving, and providing open access to scholarly works including theses, dissertations, articles, and research outputs.

Spectrum serves as the central platform for Concordia University faculty, researchers, and graduate students to deposit and discover institutional research. The repository supports multiple document types with detailed submission guidelines and technical requirements to ensure long-term preservation and accessibility.

## Getting Started

- [Welcome to Spectrum](https://spectrum.library.concordia.ca): Spectrum institutional research repository for Concordia University
- [About Spectrum](https://spectrum.library.concordia.ca/about.html): About Spectrum institutional repository and its mission
- [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://spectrum.library.concordia.ca/faq.html): FAQ for Spectrum users regarding deposits and repository use
- [Guidelines](https://spectrum.library.concordia.ca/policies.html): Deposit guidelines and procedures for Spectrum repository

## For Graduate Students

- [For Graduate Students](https://spectrum.library.concordia.ca/GraduateStudents.html): Guide for graduate students depositing theses and projects in Spectrum
- [Thesis Deposit Checklist](https://spectrum.library.concordia.ca/ThesisDepositChecklist.html): Checklist for thesis submission to Spectrum repository
- [Graduate Project (non-thesis) Deposit Checklist](https://spectrum.library.concordia.ca/GraduateProjectsDepositChecklist.html): Checklist for non-thesis graduate project submission to Spectrum
- [Embargoes](https://spectrum.library.concordia.ca/Embargoes.html): Information on embargo policies for thesis and research deposits

## For Faculty and Researchers

- [For Faculty and Researchers](https://spectrum.library.concordia.ca/FacultyResearchers.html): Guide for faculty and researchers depositing articles in Spectrum
- [Depositing Articles and More in Spectrum](https://spectrum.library.concordia.ca/DepositArticlesAndMore.html): Guide for depositing articles and scholarly works in Spectrum
- [Articles and More Checklist](https://spectrum.library.concordia.ca/ArticlesAndMoreChecklist.html): Checklist for articles and research materials deposit in Spectrum
- [Make Use of Your ORCID iD](https://spectrum.library.concordia.ca/orcid_support_advance.html): Guide to linking ORCID identifier with Spectrum profile

## Deposit Instructions and Technical Guides

- [Deposit: Navigating the Spectrum Interface](https://spectrum.library.concordia.ca/Navigating.html): Tutorial for navigating Spectrum deposit interface and workflow
- [How to Prepare PDF/A](https://spectrum.library.concordia.ca/HowToPreparePDFA.html): Tutorial for converting documents to PDF/A archival format

## Browse and Discover

- [Browse Repository](https://spectrum.library.concordia.ca/browse.html): Browse and search Spectrum institutional repository contents
- [Browse by Year](https://spectrum.library.concordia.ca/view/year): Browse Spectrum repository contents organized by publication year
- [Browse by Division and Year](https://spectrum.library.concordia.ca/view/divisions): Browse Spectrum contents by academic division and year
- [Browse by Author](https://spectrum.library.concordia.ca/view/creators): Browse Spectrum repository contents by author name
- [Browse by Document Type and Subtype](https://spectrum.library.concordia.ca/view/document_subtype): Browse Spectrum contents by document type and classification
